name: 読書計画の開始日の案内
prompt:
Revise image 1 to remove the pastel tint colors. The owner prefers neutral surfaces.
Reference 1 is the current LH05-0141 v002 card. Reference 2 is the original source for the card's structure and visible photo. Reference 3 supplies the Japanese native wording and layout. Reference 4 is the protected exact facilitator photo; keep the natural bookshelf colors and pink ring unchanged.
Create the same single landscape 16:9 component on a pure white canvas. Keep the current v002 content, hierarchy, icon, text, and overall placement. Do not add content or redesign the card.
Change only the color treatment of the UI surfaces: make the milestone badge white or a very light neutral gray, with a thin subtle neutral gray outline if needed. Remove the mint fill and any green cast, color wash, gradient, or pastel tint from all surfaces and the background. Keep the card pure white with its light neutral border. Use forest green #174C36 only for the narrow 3px top rule and the small rocket outline. Keep text near-black #1D1D1D and the role text #6E6E6E. Preserve the original photo colors and pink circular ring exactly.
Use exact Japanese text: 到達点 1, 21日間, 3月3日, 読み始めましょう, 進行役・ジャクリーン, 案内役, ようこそ！. Keep Meiryo-style text with the same regular and bold hierarchy as the prior version. No extra color accents, no tinted container, no new icon or symbol, no shadow, no gradient, no additional panel. This is a palette-only revision.
reviewNotes: Owner requested neutral surfaces; v003 removes mint tint. Known card geometry drift and exact portrait preservation remain unresolved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
